# Client Libraries

> Connect your application to your MongoDB Atlas deployment or a self-hosted MongoDB cluster by using one of the official MongoDB client libraries.

- [Client Library Compatibility Tables](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/compatibility.md): Explore compatibility tables for MongoDB client libraries, detailing server, language, and component compatibility to ensure operational environments.
- [Azure Cosmos DB Compatibility](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/cosmosdb-support.md): Explore how Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB allows using MongoDB client libraries and tools, with limitations in compatibility and feature support.
- [MongoDB .NET/C# Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp-drivers.md): Use the .NET/C# driver to connect your application to MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise, and Community database deployments.
- [Integrate MongoDB with Entity Framework and ASP.NET Core](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp-frameworks/ef-odata.md): Build an OData REST API using ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core Provider, and MongoDB and query sample data through OData endpoints.
- [Amazon DocumentDB Compatibility](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/documentdb-support.md): Explore the limited compatibility of Amazon DocumentDB with MongoDB features, commands, query operators, and aggregation stages.
- [Start Developing with MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/index.md): Connect your application to your MongoDB Atlas deployment or a self-hosted MongoDB cluster by using one of the official MongoDB client libraries.
- [MongoDB Java Client Libraries](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java-drivers.md): Use the Java Sync and Reactive Streams drivers to connect your application to work with MongoDB in Java.
- [Integrate MongoDB with Quarkus](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java-frameworks/quarkus.md): Build a REST API using Java, Quarkus, and MongoDB with JNoSQL. Learn how to connect to a MongoDB cluster and query sample data by using HTTP endpoints.
- [MongoDB Kotlin Drivers](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin-drivers.md): Explore options for integrating MongoDB with Kotlin applications using Coroutine or Sync drivers.
- [Motor (Async Driver)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/motor.md): Explore Motor, the async Python driver for MongoDB, with installation guides, connection examples, and compatibility details.
- [MongoDB Node.js Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node-drivers.md): Use the MongoDB Node.js driver and libraries, including framework integrations, to connect to MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise, and Community database deployments.
- [Integrate MongoDB with Angular](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node-frameworks/angular.md): Build a complete MEAN stack application that uses MongoDB, Express, Angular, and Node.js. Learn how to connect to MongoDB and query sample data.
- [Integrate MongoDB with Meteor and Vue](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node-frameworks/meteor-vue.md): Build a complete Meteor and Vue application that connects to MongoDB. Learn how to use Meteor's real-time features with Vue components.
- [Integrate Next.js with MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node-frameworks/next-integration.md): Learn how to build a simple full stack application that integrates Next.js with MongoDB and creates some basic API routes and React components to display data.
- [Integrate MongoDB with Nuxt and Vue](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node-frameworks/nuxt-vue.md): Build a complete Nuxt and Vue application that connects to MongoDB. Learn how to integrate MongoDB with Vue components and use Nuxt server routes.
- [Integrate MongoDB with React](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node-frameworks/react.md): Build a complete MERN stack application that uses MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js. Learn how to connect to MongoDB and query sample data.
- [Integrate MongoDB with TanStack Start](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node-frameworks/tanstack.md): Build a complete TanStack Start application that connects to MongoDB. Learn how to use TanStack Query with MongoDB to query data.
- [ORMs, ODMs, and Libraries](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/odm.md): MongoDB has ORMs, ODMs, and Libraries to simplify interactions between your app and cluster. Use the best database for Ruby, Python, Java, C#, Node.js, PHP.
- [Other Document Database Compatibility](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/other-document-dbs.md): Explore compatibility information between MongoDB and other document databases like Amazon DocumentDB and Azure Cosmos DB.
- [MongoDB PHP Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php-drivers.md): Use the PHP driver and libraries to connect to MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise, and Community database deployments.
- [Integrate MongoDB with Drupal](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php-frameworks/drupal.md): Build a Drupal content management system that connects to MongoDB. Learn how to create and query content stored in MongoDB.
- [Integrate MongoDB with LLPhant](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php-frameworks/llphant.md): Build an intelligent document search system using PHP, LLPhant, and MongoDB and create AI-powered applications with vector embeddings and semantic search.
- [Symfony MongoDB Integration](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php-frameworks/symfony.md): Build a PHP web application using Symfony with MongoDB integration, leveraging Doctrine ODM for object-document mapping and querying.
- [PHP Libraries, Frameworks, and Tools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php-libraries.md): Explore PHP libraries, frameworks, and tools for integrating MongoDB with PHP applications, including Doctrine MongoDB ODM, Laravel, Symfony, and Yii2.
- [MongoDB Python Client Libraries](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/python-drivers.md): Use the Python client libraries to connect your application to MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise, and Community database deployments.
- [MongoDB Ruby Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/ruby-drivers.md): Explore the MongoDB Ruby Driver and Mongoid ODM for integrating MongoDB with Ruby applications.
- [MongoDB Rust Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust-drivers.md): Use the MongoDB Rust driver and libraries, including framework integrations, to connect to MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise, and Community database deployments.
- [Integrate MongoDB with Actix](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust-frameworks/actix.md): Build a  web application that uses MongoDB as the backend and Actix as the web framework. Learn how to use Actix with MongoDB to query data.
- [Integrate MongoDB with Rocket](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust-frameworks/rocket.md): Build a complete web application using Rust, Rocket, and MongoDB with Handlebars templates. Learn how to connect to MongoDB and display sample data.
- [MongoDB Swift Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/swift.md): Explore how to use the MongoDB Swift driver to connect to MongoDB, noting its compatibility and installation options.
- [TypeScript](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/typescript.md): Explore how to use TypeScript with the Node.js Driver for MongoDB applications.
